user.title: Choose a Lumalou
user.description: Choose a connectable Lumalou discovered by Home Assistant.

data_description.address: Only connectable advertisements matching the known Lumalou pattern are shown. Select the candidate you recognize as your Lumalou; setup verifies its signed identity. Read the complete profile before control is enabled.

bluetooth_confirm.title: Add {name}?
bluetooth_confirm.description: Confirm that this is your Lumalou. Home Assistant checks standard Bluetooth Device Information for conflicts and verifies the signed device identity. A private fingerprint binds later sessions. Read the complete profile before control is enabled; no identifier is shown or logged.

reconfigure.title: Reconnect Lumalou
reconfigure.description: Select the discovered Lumalou to reconnect. Home Assistant verifies its signed device identity; an enrolled device must match its private fingerprint. Read the complete profile before control is enabled.

data_description.address: Choose the connectable Lumalou candidate you want to use.

error.cannot_connect: Could not connect for the read-only identity probe. Make sure no other app is connected and try again.
error.device_unavailable: The selected device is no longer available. Try again.
error.identity_unconfirmed: Home Assistant could not verify a supported device identity. No device entry was created.
error.unsupported_product_code: The device explicitly reports a different model. This integration cannot use it.
error.wrong_device: The selected Lumalou is not the device bound to this entry. Choose the right device, or add the other one as a new entry.

abort.already_in_progress: Configuration for this device is already in progress.
abort.no_devices_found: No connectable advertisements matching the known Lumalou pattern were found.
abort.not_connectable: This Bluetooth path cannot connect to the device.
abort.unsupported_device: The advertisement does not match the known Lumalou pattern.

init.title: Edit Lumalou
init.description: Edit the saved profile that Home Assistant keeps for this Lumalou. Saving an editor creates a pending revision and does not change the device; the `lumalou.restore_profile` action writes it to Lumalou and verifies it. Reading the device profile again replaces the saved profile.

read_first.title: Read the device profile first
read_first.description: No complete, supported profile is saved for this Lumalou yet. Read it first: after you confirm it, it becomes the saved profile, device control is unlocked and the profile editors become available. Nothing is written to the device.

read_profile_confirm.title: Confirm device profile read
read_profile_confirm.description: Fresh device read: light brightness {brightness}, color {color}, volume {volume}; {song_count} playlist songs; {wake_count} Ready-to-Rise times, {bedtime_count} Sleepy times and {alarm_count} alarms per week; routines on {routine_days} days with {task_count} tasks. It replaces the saved profile at revision {revision}. Nothing is written to Lumalou.

data.confirm: Save this complete device snapshot as the desired profile

behavior.title: Behavior options
behavior.description: Automatic restore is off by default. When it is on and Lumalou reappears with settings that differ from the saved verified profile (for example after a power loss reset them), Home Assistant writes the saved profile back and checks it with a fresh read. Any other change made on the device, including in the Fisher-Price app, is overwritten too. If two attempts fail, a repair is raised instead. When it is off, a repair lets you choose which settings to keep.

data_description.auto_restore: Applies only to a profile that was verified on this device. Nothing is restored while maintenance mode is on.

basic.title: Light and audio values
basic.description: Values from the saved profile. Saving creates a pending revision; nothing is sent to the device.

playlist.title: Ordered playlist
playlist.description: Use fixed rows to preserve order and duplicates. Clear every row for an empty playlist. Nothing is sent to the device.

clock_settings.title: Clock settings
clock_settings.description: Edit the saved clock-settings block. Nothing is sent to the device.

routine_settings.title: Routine settings
routine_settings.description: Edit the saved routine-settings block. Music and volume are raw values from 0 to 15, as Lumalou reports them, not named modes. Nothing is sent to the device.

schedule.title: Weekly Ready-to-Rise and Sleepy times
schedule.description: A disabled time is stored as no time. An enabled 00:00 time is stored as midnight. The time control remains visible when disabled; the switch determines which value is saved.

schedule_copy.title: Copy weekly times
schedule_copy.description: For each time block, choose a source day and optional target days. Selected targets are replaced with independent copies, including an unset time or midnight. Other days remain unchanged.

schedule_alarm.title: Weekly alarm offsets
schedule_alarm.description: Choose each day's source-defined alarm offset and one alarm sound. Sound numbers are preserved exactly; hardware behavior is not yet verified.

routine.title: Choose a routine day
routine.description: Each day stores an independent routine.

routine_tasks.title: Edit daily routine
routine_tasks.description: Rows are stored in order. Clear a row to remove it. Existing source task ID 0 rows are retained but are not shown as a named choice. Drag-and-drop reordering is unavailable in Home Assistant options flows; move choices between fixed rows instead.

routine_copy.title: Copy routine
routine_copy.description: Optionally replace routines on selected days with independent copies of this routine.

schedule_confirm.title: Confirm weekly schedule
schedule_confirm.description: Revision {revision}: {ready_count} Ready-to-Rise times, {sleepy_count} Sleepy times, {alarm_count} enabled alarms, alarm sound {alarm_sound}. Saving changes only the private profile; it does not write to the device.

routine_confirm.title: Confirm daily routine
routine_confirm.description: Revision {revision}: {day}, {task_count} task rows, {copy_count} matching copied days, {zero_count} preserved unnamed task ID 0 rows. Saving changes only the private profile; it does not write to the device.

basic_confirm.title: Confirm light and audio values
basic_confirm.description: Revision {revision}: brightness {brightness}, color {color}, light duration {light_duration}, volume {volume}, playlist duration {playlist_duration}. Saving changes only the private profile; it does not write to the device.

playlist_confirm.title: Confirm playlist
playlist_confirm.description: Revision {revision}: {song_count} song rows: {songs}. Saving changes only the private profile; it does not write to the device.

clock_settings_confirm.title: Confirm clock settings
clock_settings_confirm.description: Revision {revision}: display {display}, brightness {brightness}, format {format}. Saving changes only the private profile; it does not write to the device.

routine_settings_confirm.title: Confirm routine settings
routine_settings_confirm.description: Revision {revision}: enabled {enabled}, music {music}, volume {volume}, task reward sound {task_reward_sfx}, routine reward sound {routine_reward_sfx}. Saving changes only the private profile; it does not write to the device.

error.invalid_schedule_copy: Choose supported source and target days for schedule copying.
error.invalid_schedule_alarm: Choose a supported alarm offset and sound.
error.invalid_routine_tasks: Use no more than 12 supported task rows and a valid minute-resolution time.
error.invalid_basic: Choose supported light and audio values.
error.invalid_playlist: Use at most 12 song IDs from 1 through 12.
error.invalid_clock_settings: Choose a supported clock display, brightness, and format.
error.invalid_routine_settings: Use whole music and volume values from 0 to 15 and supported reward sounds.
error.revision_conflict: The profile changed while this editor was open. Cancel and reopen it to use the latest revision.
error.profile_save_failed: The profile could not be saved. Nothing was changed.

abort.entry_not_loaded: Load the Lumalou entry before reading or editing its profile.
abort.profile_read_failed: Home Assistant could not obtain a complete, consistent fresh device profile. The saved profile was not changed.
abort.profile_not_read: Read the complete profile from the device first.

export_profile.name: Export profile
export_profile.description: Return the private saved profile and its current revision for backup and conflict-safe import.

import_profile.name: Import profile
import_profile.description: Validate and save a private profile without sending raw protocol commands.

config_entry_id.name: Device
config_entry_id.description: Lumalou configuration entry that owns the profile.

profile.name: Profile
profile.description: Profile object previously exported by this integration.

expected_revision.name: Expected revision
expected_revision.description: Required current revision used to reject concurrent edits.

restore_profile.name: Restore profile
restore_profile.description: Write the saved profile to Lumalou (only the blocks that differ) and verify the result with a fresh read.

expected_revision.name: Expected revision
expected_revision.description: Optional saved revision to restore; the action fails if the profile changed. Defaults to the current revision.

config_entry_not_found.message: The selected Lumalou configuration entry was not found.

config_entry_not_loaded.message: The selected Lumalou configuration entry is not loaded.

restore_write.message: Writing the profile to Lumalou failed after {applied} of {planned} steps. The saved profile is unchanged; run the restore again.

restore_verify.message: All {planned} profile writes were sent, but Lumalou could not be read back to verify them. Run the restore again.

restore_mismatch.message: Lumalou did not keep {count} settings groups after the restore. Run the restore again, or read the device profile to keep the device settings. The log and diagnostics name the affected groups.

profile_other_device.message: The saved profile was verified on a different Lumalou. Read the profile from this device instead.

maintenance_mode.message: Lumalou is in maintenance mode. Turn maintenance mode off first.

control_locked.message: Read and confirm the device profile in the Lumalou options before controlling the device.

identity_not_enrolled.message: This Lumalou entry has no verified device identity. Reconfigure the entry.

profile_read_failed.message: Could not read a complete, consistent profile from Lumalou. Nothing was written.

revision_conflict.message: The saved profile changed. Use its current revision and try again.

invalid_profile.message: The saved or supplied profile is incomplete or contains values Lumalou cannot keep (routine music and volume must be 0 to 15). Read the device profile again or import a valid profile.

command_failed.message: The Lumalou command failed and will not be retried. Check that Lumalou is nearby and try again.

refresh_failed.message: Could not read the current Lumalou state. Check that Lumalou is nearby and try again.

profile_storage_unhealthy.message: The saved Lumalou profile could not be read. Follow the Repairs issue to recover it first.

clock_untrusted.message: The Home Assistant clock does not look set, so the Lumalou clock was not changed.

import_profile.title: Import a saved Lumalou profile
import_profile.description: Home Assistant could not read the saved Lumalou profile, so automatic profile writes are blocked. Paste JSON returned by the Lumalou export action. It is validated now; neither storage nor the device is changed at this step. The unreadable file will be preserved during confirmed recovery.

confirm.title: Confirm profile recovery
confirm.description: The backup contains {field_count} persistent profile fields. Recovery preserves the unreadable storage bytes in a private backup, then saves this profile as pending. It does not write to Lumalou.

data.confirm: Replace unreadable storage with this profile

error.invalid_profile: Enter a valid profile exported by this integration.
error.recovery_failed: Recovery could not be saved and verified. The unreadable source remains preserved.

abort.entry_not_loaded: Load the Lumalou entry before repairing its profile.

identity_enrollment.title: Verify the device for {title}
identity_enrollment.description: This Lumalou entry was created before signed device verification, so Home Assistant does not connect to it. Open Settings > Devices & services > Lumalou, choose Reconfigure for this entry and select your Lumalou. Its entities and history are kept.

profile_restore_needed.title: Lumalou settings differ from the saved profile

init.title: Choose which Lumalou settings to keep
init.description: A fresh read shows {block_count} profile blocks that differ from the saved verified profile, for example because a power loss reset the device. Automatic restore attempts so far: {attempts}.

restore.title: Restore saved profile
restore.description: Home Assistant writes only the differing blocks of the saved profile to Lumalou and verifies them with a fresh read.

keep_device.title: Keep device settings
keep_device.description: Home Assistant reads the current device settings and saves them as the new verified profile. Nothing is written to Lumalou.

error.restore_failed: The restore failed or could not be verified. Check that Lumalou is nearby and try again.
error.keep_device_failed: The device profile could not be read and saved. Check that Lumalou is nearby and try again.

abort.not_needed: The device settings already match the saved profile.

state.restore_mismatch: Device did not keep the profile
